findings.desc: CHK-003:happy:0, CHK-003:happy:1, CHK-003:happy:2 (all cli/must): each intent explicitly requires invoking the handler (review_escalation_status / policy_set / fallback_set) under a wrapper-root layout and asserting report.materialHash === floor.materialHash. The evidence for all three points to review-escalation-smoke.js, which is a plain-repo-only smoke with no wrapper-root layout setup. The notes acknowledge this by saying evaluation equivalence is proven indirectly via the freshness-root smoke, but that is a transitive proxy argument, not the direct handler+wrapper-root execution the intents prescribe. The `cli/must` intents are not fulfilled by plain-smoke evidence.

CHK-002:happy:1 and CHK-002:happy:2 (both cli/must): each intent requires invoking the DONE-readiness path of StoryMachine (canFinishGuard at machine.ts ~639 and getGuardFailureReason at machine.ts ~1140) under a wrapper-root layout and asserting escalation.materialHash === floor.materialHash. The evidence for both is kind=logic_test (code inspection of machine.ts), not a cli execution under a wrapper-root layout. CHK-002:happy:0 uses done-oracle-wrapper-root-smoke.js which covers the done-oracle.ts call site, but the two machine.ts call sites are only verified by static inspection. The cli/must intents for these two machine.ts paths are not fulfilled by logic_test inspection evidence.

Host-2 (Codex) review: the machine-guard coverage in review-escalation-freshness-root-smoke.ts is not a genuine regression guard. canFinishGuard / getGuardFailureReason return early (test-evidence/delivery-check gates) before reaching the evaluateReviewEscalation call site, and the escViaMachineExpr assertion tests a COPY of the gitCwd expression outside the guard. Reverting the machine.ts:639/1145 gitCwd plumbing would NOT fail the smoke. Fix: seed a DONE-ready wrapper-root fixture (PASS test-evidence + valid signed delivery-check + escalation-required policy + 3x2 host verdicts bound to currentMaterialHash(gitRoot,HEAD,metaRoot)) so canFinishGuard reaches and DEPENDS on the escalation call; assert canFinishGuard(gitCwd:gitRoot)===true and (gitCwd:metaRoot)===false.
findings.resolvedReason: Re-review verified commit 605c39854 added a DONE-ready wrapper-root fixture: PASS test evidence, signed fresh delivery-check, explicit high-risk escalation policy, and 3x2 host verdicts bound to currentMaterialHash(gitRoot,HEAD,metaRoot). Baseline build+smoke passed. Temporarily removing gitCwd from canFinishGuard evaluateReviewEscalation compiled but made review-escalation-freshness-root-smoke fail at the canFinishGuard green assertion; restoring machine.ts made build+smoke pass again. Production machine.ts and done-oracle.ts still thread gitCwd.
